invariants.rationale: Used as a key to look up projectClassMembers; being null would likely cause a bug or unwanted behavior.
Properties will be written to without a null check, so should be non-null.
Used for property lookup and in get/properties access; null would cause NPE.
className is used as a key to look up classes; empty string is likely not meaningful.
Properties for className are loaded into classProperties, so it may initially not contain them.
